description: This file defines the interface ISiloPersistentStreamConfigurator and extension methods for configuring persistent streams in Orleans, including setting up pulling agents, lifecycle, partition balancing, and backoff providers.

classes.name: SiloPersistentStreamConfiguratorExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods for configuring persistent streams in Orleans.

methods.name: ConfigurePullingAgent
methods.description: Configures the pulling agent with optional options.

methods.name: ConfigureLifecycle
methods.description: Configures the lifecycle of the persistent stream.

methods.name: ConfigurePartitionBalancing
methods.description: Configures partition balancing with a factory method.

methods.name: ConfigureBackoffProvider (message delivery)
methods.description: Configures the message delivery backoff provider.

methods.name: ConfigureBackoffProvider (queue reader)
methods.description: Configures the queue reader backoff provider.

methods.name: ConfigurePartitionBalancing (generic)
methods.description: Configures partition balancing with a factory and options delegate.
